title: Fleurs D'Un Songe
identity: Dia Succari’s Fleurs d’un songe (also rendered Fleur d’un songe) is an original alto saxophone and piano work published by Alphonse Leduc, AL28899. The CDMC Alsace library record gives 1994 publication, 5:10 duration and its internal year-8 rating. A 2026 CDMC regional repertoire document lists it in FC2.
